notes.title: Game Updated from 1.02 to 1.03!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! SO SORRY about the errors so far. The biggest of which is [b]NO ACHIEVEMENTS[/b].

[i]Ouch[/i].

Still, everything SHOULD be in order now. As a way of saying sorry I am going to give you the password for the [i][b]Special Hidden Chest[/b][/i] in Shawping.

[spoiler]I had originally planned on making it a bigger thing, with clues released slowly, but ugh...Day one issues, right?! Anyway, it's the first screen name I ever had with AIM:

DpthChrg112

Enjoy your weapon, cheaters ;)[/spoiler]

Anyway, here is what all changed:

[h1]Game Updated to 1.03 (Venture Build)[/h1][list]
[*] Achievements should now be working.
[*] Errant periods that were on vacation have been put back into place
[*] Various typos have been fixed.
[*] Sherberta's battler has had odd image artifcating fixed.
[*] Free Will has been removed at the Mountain Maze.
[*] Peck no longer causes the UI to disappear.
[*] Berry Blast was nerfed slightly.
[*] Skills that were combat only can no longer be used outside of combat.
[*] Hawk no longer disappears if you talk to him from the side.
[/list]
